reviews.body:
Looks clean and well-scoped — checking event activation ahead of `matchesFeatureFlags` avoids premature `$feature_flag_called` events on ordinary linked/feature flags before an event-triggered survey activates, while keeping eligibility semantics and post-activation tracking unchanged.

**Follow-up:** For cross-SDK parity (`PostHog/team-client-libraries`), we should open a cross-SDK policy decision in `PostHog/sdk-specs` (`openspec/specs/surveys/spec.md`) and align `PostHog/posthog-ios` (`PostHogSurveyIntegration.swift`) and `PostHog/posthog-js` browser (`surveys-renderer.tsx`, while preserving explicit `displaySurvey` behavior) with equivalent regression tests, since both currently evaluate ordinary linked flags before checking event activation. Not blocking for this PR.

AI-assisted review.
